originals.why: symud is taught as 이사하다 (move house). Here it means physical movement, so in Korean 'move house towards the bus' is nonsense. No faithful Korean is possible with the taught gloss.

originals.why: Same problem as o3: symud = 이사하다 (move house) gives a nonsensical Korean prompt for moving towards a bus.
